scores.note: Option 1 failed (echo of 'afraid') and sits at the top, so the best picks (5 hesitant, 6 reluctant) are buried. 2 fearful and 7 apprehensive read better with 'of/about speaking'; 3 scared and 8 nervous are plain/casual; 10 unwilling loses the fear. 4 'timid' describes a trait and does not take 'to speak up' (0). 9 'dreadful' is the wrong sense, meaning terrible (0).
